bio.text: Bernadette Wilson is a Republican candidate for governor of Alaska in 2026 and has not previously held elected office.

She was born on the Kenai Peninsula, raised in Anchorage, and owns Denali Disposal, a trash collection service in Anchorage; according to her campaign website, she launched the commercial waste management company in 2016.
She previously hosted a talk radio show, was Alaska director of Americans for Prosperity, and worked for the Alaska Policy Forum.
She advised Nick Begich's 2024 congressional campaign.

sources.title: Third Republican candidate, Bernadette Wilson, enters Alaska governor's race
